## Backtest

```{python}
s, h, bm = bt["strategy"], bt["strategy_beta_hedged"], bt["benchmark"]
st = perf_stats(s, 52)
stat_tiles([
    ("CAGR", pct(st["CAGR"]), "pos" if st["CAGR"] > 0 else "neg"),
    ("Volatility", pct(st["Volatility"], False), ""),
    ("Sharpe", f'{st["Sharpe"]:.2f}', ""),
    ("Max drawdown", pct(st["Max drawdown"], False), "neg"),
    ("Calmar", f'{st["Calmar"]:.2f}', ""),
])
```

<p class="asof">Weekly, `{python} f"{bt.index[1]:%b %Y}"` to `{python} f"{bt.index[-1]:%b %Y}"`. Net of trading costs. The portfolio is equal-weight long / short and dollar-neutral. The equity benchmark (EQWL, equal-weight large caps) is hidden on the chart by default; click its legend entry to show it.</p>

## How it works

::: {.method}
- **Universe:** 30 country and regional equity ETFs across developed and emerging markets.
- **Factors:** each market is scored on **value** (valuation yields), **quality** (profitability and balance-sheet strength), **growth** (earnings and sales growth) and **momentum** (price trend). Every factor is standardised against the market's own history and then across markets.
- **Portfolio:** markets are ranked on the average of the factor scores. The strategy goes long the top-ranked markets and short the bottom-ranked, with equal weights on each side.
- **Rebalance:** weekly.
- **Beta-hedged variant:** an overlay that offsets the portfolio's estimated equity-market beta.
:::
